name: @takip/mobile
description: The iOS and Android apps: native shells around takip.dev

scripts.android:debug: npm run sync && cd android && nice ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run sync && cd android && nice ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.ios:build: npm run sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath ios/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.ios:open: npm run sync && cap open ios
